reason: A free audit that wants our open POs, jobs and inventory sent to a startup I've never heard of is the first thing I'd question. Sending that data out needs IT and security sign-off, and I'd check with our Epicor partner before anything leaves the building, which won't happen within 30 days.
objection: A free audit means you'll try to sell me something next, and I'd be handing over sanitized exports that still show our supplier and job exposure to an outside company.
would_change_my_mind: Our Epicor partner vouches for them and IT approves the data handling in writing, plus a reference from a similar plant that caught a real supplier miss we had not already seen.
